item.title: The Crimson White wins multiple awards at SEJC
item.description: The Crimson White won multiple awards at the Southeast Journalism Conference in Cartersville, Georgia, last weekend. item.title: City council renews recycling program
item.description: The Tuscaloosa City Council renewed the West Alabama recycling program for the fiscal year of 2027 on Tuesday.
